title: QuEra Aquila 中性原子類比機
summary: 以可重排幾何與 Rydberg 多體類比模擬解析QuEra Aquila 中性原子類比機：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore QuEra Aquila neutral-atom analog machine through reconfigurable geometry and rydberg many-body simulation: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 依公開研究與裝置資料編寫的離線模型、編譯及證據判讀。不是實機組裝、雷射或低溫作業SOP；假想算例不代表廠商精度、量子優勢或容錯能力。研發宣稱與已驗證觀測分開標示。
scopeEn: Offline models, compilation and evidence interpretation from public research/device sources. Not hardware assembly, laser/cryogenic SOPs; assumed examples are not vendor fidelity, advantage or fault tolerance. Development claims and demonstrated observations remain distinct.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在QuEra Aquila 中性原子類比機案例中比較Aquila光鑷佔位與Rydberg距離耦合，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate aquila tweezer occupancy and rydberg distance coupling within the QuEra Aquila neutral-atom analog machine case.

steps.title: 光鑷陣列與裝載：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Optical-tweezer arrays and loading: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Aquila光鑷佔位提出可反駁的光鑷陣列與裝載模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable optical-tweezer arrays and loading model and evidence record for aquila tweezer occupancy.
steps.instruction: 在「QuEra Aquila 中性原子類比機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Aquila光鑷佔位。中性原子由光學勢能井定位；裝載缺位與重排決定可用幾何。 建立光鑷陣列與裝載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可重排幾何與 Rydberg 多體類比模擬。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由假想佔位圖統計完整陣列率與重排次數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify aquila tweezer occupancy in the mentor diagram and primary sources for QuEra Aquila neutral-atom analog machine. Optical potentials position neutral atoms; loading vacancies and rearrangement determine usable geometry. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of optical-tweezer arrays and loading, focusing on reconfigurable geometry and rydberg many-body simulation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compute full-array fraction and moves from a hypothetical occupancy map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 由假想佔位圖統計完整陣列率與重排次數。
steps.observationEn: Compute full-array fraction and moves from a hypothetical occupancy map.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：名義陷阱數等於每次實驗的可用原子數。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Nominal traps equal available atoms on every run.
steps.check: 提交Aquila光鑷佔位的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for aquila tweezer occupancy.

knowledge.title: 光鑷陣列與裝載
knowledge.text: 中性原子由光學勢能井定位；裝載缺位與重排決定可用幾何。 本課架構對應：Aquila光鑷佔位
knowledge.textEn: Optical potentials position neutral atoms; loading vacancies and rearrangement determine usable geometry. Course architecture correspondence: Aquila tweezer occupancy

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 由假想佔位圖統計完整陣列率與重排次數。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；名義陷阱數等於每次實驗的可用原子數。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compute full-array fraction and moves from a hypothetical occupancy map. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Nominal traps equal available atoms on every run.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設兩原子交互作用能移服從 U=C6/r⁶，距離增為 1.07 倍且 C6 固定，U 比率=1.07⁻⁶=0.666342。這是兩體尺度比較，未含驅動、多體及讀出，非裝置控制設定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume U=C6/r^6 for a pair. Increasing separation by 1.07 at fixed C6 changes U by 1.07^-6=0.666342. This omits drive, many-body effects and readout and is not a device setting.

quiz.question: 就Aquila光鑷佔位的「光鑷陣列與裝載」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for optical-tweezer arrays and loading in aquila tweezer occupancy?
options: 中性原子由光學勢能井定位；裝載缺位與重排決定可用幾何。
名義陷阱數等於每次實驗的可用原子數。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Optical potentials position neutral atoms; loading vacancies and rearrangement determine usable geometry.
Nominal traps equal available atoms on every run.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 中性原子由光學勢能井定位；裝載缺位與重排決定可用幾何。 由假想佔位圖統計完整陣列率與重排次數。
quiz.explanationEn: Optical potentials position neutral atoms; loading vacancies and rearrangement determine usable geometry. Compute full-array fraction and moves from a hypothetical occupancy map.

steps.title: 光鑷陣列與裝載：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Optical-tweezer arrays and loading: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對Aquila光鑷佔位提出可反駁的光鑷陣列與裝載模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable optical-tweezer arrays and loading model and evidence record for aquila tweezer occupancy.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「光鑷陣列與裝載」模型，檢查Aquila光鑷佔位的兩個假想案例。由假想佔位圖統計完整陣列率與重排次數。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分中性原子由光學勢能井定位；裝載缺位與重排決定可用幾何。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous optical-tweezer arrays and loading model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving aquila tweezer occupancy. Compute full-array fraction and moves from a hypothetical occupancy map. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Optical potentials position neutral atoms; loading vacancies and rearrangement determine usable geometry." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 由假想佔位圖統計完整陣列率與重排次數。
steps.observationEn: Compute full-array fraction and moves from a hypothetical occupancy map.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：名義陷阱數等於每次實驗的可用原子數。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Nominal traps equal available atoms on every run.
steps.check: 提交Aquila光鑷佔位的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for aquila tweezer occupancy.

steps.title: Rydberg 阻塞與距離：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Rydberg blockade and distance: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Rydberg距離耦合提出可反駁的Rydberg 阻塞與距離模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable rydberg blockade and distance model and evidence record for rydberg distance coupling.
steps.instruction: 在「QuEra Aquila 中性原子類比機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Rydberg距離耦合。Rydberg 相互作用對原子距離敏感；常見模型以 C6/r6 描述兩體位移。 建立Rydberg 阻塞與距離的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可重排幾何與 Rydberg 多體類比模擬。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在固定 C6 的假想模型比較 1.0 與 1.1 倍距離。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify rydberg distance coupling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for QuEra Aquila neutral-atom analog machine. Rydberg interactions depend strongly on distance; common models use C6/r6 for pair shifts. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of rydberg blockade and distance, focusing on reconfigurable geometry and rydberg many-body simulation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare 1.0 and 1.1 separation at fixed assumed C6. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在固定 C6 的假想模型比較 1.0 與 1.1 倍距離。
steps.observationEn: Compare 1.0 and 1.1 separation at fixed assumed C6.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：原子距離改變隻影響圖像，不影響哈密頓量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Atom spacing changes only the picture, not the Hamiltonian.
steps.check: 提交Rydberg距離耦合的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for rydberg distance coupling.

options: 原子距離改變隻影響圖像，不影響哈密頓量。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
Rydberg 相互作用對原子距離敏感；常見模型以 C6/r6 描述兩體位移。
optionsEn: Atom spacing changes only the picture, not the Hamiltonian.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Rydberg interactions depend strongly on distance; common models use C6/r6 for pair shifts.
